method: simulateTransaction, sigVerify false, nothing signed or sent. A seed buy of 1015229000 lamports into a fresh battle, then a second buy bisected to find the smallest the program accepts. The fee wallet was fee payer only because it holds the balance a 1 SOL pool needs; no lamports move in a simulation.
note: Our curve reads a raw delta of 99999 at 287167, where the program reads at least 100000. The models diverge by one to two token units in 100000 - 0.002 percent - which is exact for pricing and not bit-exact at the quantisation boundary.
